stories.title: A structured curriculum for learning GPU performance engineering and inference
stories.why_read: Read this to build a bottom-up mental model of AI performance engineering, spanning from GPU hardware architecture and low-level kernel optimization up to production inference engines and distributed serving.

stories.title: Reusing suffix kv caches improves serving efficiency during context edits
stories.why_read: Learn how suffix cache reuse eliminates redundant token recomputation during non-append-only context edits. It provides a clear mental model for optimizing KV cache serving efficiency in context language models.

stories.title: How ClickHouse achieves query performance through architectural design
stories.why_read: Read this to build an architectural intuition for ClickHouse optimization by understanding how columnar storage and fundamental data-reduction principles drive extreme query performance.

stories.title: Running frontier MoE models locally with asymmetric quantization
stories.why_read: Learn how DwarfStar 4 enables local execution of massive mixture-of-experts models through asymmetric quantization and disk-persisted KV caching. This provides a clear architectural model for running frontier models efficiently on consumer hardware.

stories.title: Frontier models with grep match modern retrieval pipelines
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how different retrieval architectures perform against messy, real-world company data. You will learn the performance trade-offs between traditional RAG pipelines, modern hybrid search, and agentic grep workflows.

stories.title: Building robust directory sync without relying on SCIM
stories.why_read: Learn why standard SCIM implementations struggle with identity management and how custom sync engines handle complex user and group state transitions.

stories.title: Targeting pivotal decisions improves credit assignment in agentic reinforcement learning
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how ProVer verifies pivotal trajectory segments to resolve the credit assignment limitations of GRPO in LLM agents.

stories.title: Lightpanda reaches production readiness as a lightweight headless browser
stories.why_read: Learn how Lightpanda built a lightweight browser engine from scratch in Zig to execute modern JavaScript and extract web data at a fraction of Chrome's resource cost.

stories.title: Enki enables single source heterogeneous GPU compute in pure Rust
stories.why_read: Read this to discover how Enki compiles standard Rust functions directly to GPU silicon without foreign shading languages or nightly toolchains. You will learn how it unifies CPU and GPU execution in a single codebase.

stories.title: Pyronaut brings high performance to Python services via GraalVM
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how Pyronaut integrates Python with GraalVM and Micronaut to achieve low latency and significantly higher server throughput.

stories.title: Extracting clean user tasks from noisy agent execution traces
stories.why_read: Learn how to isolate verbatim user requests from cluttered agent prompts at scale. This understanding helps you diagnose run failures and build better evaluation datasets from production traffic.

stories.title: Llama.cpp adds single forward pass decision model scoring
stories.why_read: Understand how decision models in llama.cpp score predefined options in a single forward pass without autoregressive token generation. This enables significantly faster and more reliable routing, moderation, and agent action selection.

stories.title: Benchmarking language models on architecture specific GPU kernel optimization
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how large language models perform and adapt when generating low-level, architecture-specific PTX for GPU kernel optimization.

stories.title: Integrating Rust into CPython aims to reduce crash bugs
stories.why_read: Read this to understand why Python core developers are evaluating Rust to eliminate memory crashes stemming from complex additions like free-threading and JIT compilation.

stories.title: Integrated vector search in Postgres outperforms dedicated external engines
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how Lakebase achieves low-latency vector and full-text search directly inside Postgres without separate ETL pipelines. You will learn the architectural trade-offs of decoupling storage and compute for AI retrieval workloads.

stories.title: Building an end-to-end machine learning compiler from scratch
stories.why_read: Read this syllabus to understand how to engineer an ML compiler from scratch through hands-on implementation. It provides a structured path from elementary operations to training state-of-the-art models on GPUs while emphasizing rigorous code quality.

stories.title: Azure API connections architecture enables full cross-tenant compromises
stories.why_read: Understand how architectural flaws and brittle input validation layers in Azure API Connections allow attackers to achieve global cross-tenant access to sensitive cloud backends.

stories.title: Dissecting GPU-initiated communication at the hardware and library boundary
stories.why_read: This paper breaks down the low-level mechanics and latency overheads of direct GPU-to-NIC RDMA operations across modern NVIDIA architectures. You will gain a clear mental model of how communication libraries impact fine-grained network performance in Mixture-of-Experts workloads.

stories.title: Cross-model trajectory transport enables closed-form weight surgery
stories.why_read: Learn how aligning hidden representation trajectories enables direct weight surgery between different transformer architectures without requiring massive training compute.

stories.title: Building crash-resilient Go AI agents with durable execution
stories.why_read: Learn how to design crash-resilient AI agent workflows in Go that persist state and tool executions across process restarts.

stories.title: Accelerating object storage reads with resilient NVMe caching
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how to design an ultra-low-latency NVMe cache for S3 that resists scan pollution and replicates hot keys dynamically. It provides practical architectural patterns for maintaining cache warmth during cluster resizing.

stories.title: New matrix multiplication kernels accelerate CPU prompt evaluation in llamafile
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how custom matrix multiplication kernels dramatically accelerate prompt evaluation for local language models running on CPUs.

stories.title: Cloudflare Basin launches serverless data analytics on Apache Iceberg
stories.why_read: Understand how Cloudflare Basin leverages Apache Iceberg and R2 to provide an end-to-end serverless data platform. Readers will learn how distributed querying and zero egress costs simplify data lake pipelines.

stories.title: Minimizing query router overhead by decoding data lazily
stories.why_read: Learn how designing database middleware to lazily decode wire protocols reduces latency and CPU overhead. It offers practical architectural insights into building high-throughput database proxies.

stories.title: Resolving excessive gcache page file accumulation in MySQL clusters
stories.why_read: Understand the root causes of gcache page file accumulation in Percona XtraDB Cluster environments. You will learn diagnostic techniques to identify cluster changes that trigger disk space exhaustion.

stories.title: Why modern AI datacenters need Homa rather than TCP
stories.why_read: Understand why traditional TCP struggles with emerging AI workloads and how the Homa transport protocol provides a drop-in networking alternative.

stories.title: NVIDIA OpenShell provides safe runtime for autonomous AI agents
stories.why_read: Read this repository overview to understand how OpenShell establishes a secure, private execution environment for autonomous AI agents.

stories.title: Building a green thread runtime from scratch in Rust
stories.why_read: Read this to understand the fundamental mechanics of how user-space green threads manage stacks and registers without kernel intervention. You will gain a clear mental model of context switching and lightweight runtime internals.

stories.title: How coding agents render interactive inputs in terminals
stories.why_read: Learn the trade-offs between main and alternate screen buffers when building interactive terminal user interfaces that preserve native scrollback and selection.

stories.title: Executing Python code outperforms tool calling in robot manipulation
stories.why_read: Learn how replacing iterative tool calling with Python code generation cuts token overhead and improves task success rates in robot manipulation agents. It presents a mechanistic fix for the high cost and latency of vision-language robot planning.

stories.title: Joint scaling of recurrence and sparsity boosts model efficiency
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how combining recurrent looping and sparse mixture-of-experts creates predictable scaling laws and significantly improves compute and parameter efficiency on reasoning tasks.

stories.title: Postgres memory tuning leaves databases vulnerable to bad queries
stories.why_read: Read this to understand the mechanics of Postgres memory management, specifically why work_mem budgets can cause unexpectedly high RAM usage and threaten system reliability.

stories.title: Software is moving from calling models to compiling semantic functions
stories.why_read: This piece outlines how modern AI architectures are shifting away from raw model invocation toward compiled, modular semantic functions that dramatically lower latency.

stories.title: Sampling transforms off-policy data to improve supervised finetuning
stories.why_read: Learn how an MCMC sampling algorithm adapts off-policy data to be more on-policy, enabling supervised finetuning to rival reinforcement learning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

stories.title: LLMs will orchestrate AI compilers rather than replace them
stories.why_read: This article explains why LLMs will act as orchestrators and code generators driving traditional compiler infrastructure rather than executing direct end-to-end compilation.

stories.title: Compositional query builders solve structural limitations of generating SQL
stories.why_read: Learn why SQL syntax makes programmatic query generation difficult and how compositional interfaces offer a more expressive approach to query building.

stories.title: Extending SWE-2 reward functions to steer Pareto frontier improvements
stories.why_read: Learn how dynamically updating reward function penalties during post-training lets developers deliberately steer model trade-offs between cost and solve rate along the Pareto curve.

stories.title: Playbook for containing secrets leaked by autonomous coding agents
stories.why_read: This article offers a practical incident response and forensics playbook for remediating credentials and personal data exposed publicly by autonomous coding agents.

stories.title: Using fast decision models significantly optimizes LLM serving systems
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how lightweight decision models can optimize low-level serving mechanics like request scheduling. You will learn how predictive classification improves service-level objective compliance and dramatically reduces latency.

stories.title: Most autonomous agent failures in production evade automated detection
stories.why_read: Understand how autonomous agents fail silently in live business workflows and why standard automated monitoring misses the vast majority of errors.

stories.title: Custom fuzzers can uncover subtle regular expression matching bugs
stories.why_read: Learn how to construct targeted fuzzers to discover subtle edge-case bugs that evade standard unit tests. The text demonstrates practical generative testing techniques through a concrete regex case study.

stories.title: Offloading database queues to Kafka reduces FoundationDB transaction load
stories.why_read: Read this to understand the concrete architectural trade-offs of using a database as a message queue versus a dedicated streaming broker. You will learn how task scheduling, scanning, and custom queuing logic create database contention at scale.

stories.title: Vector databases alone cannot provide time-aware agent memory
stories.why_read: Read this to understand why standard vector retrieval fails at tracking temporal changes and how time-aware architectures provide durable agent memory.

stories.title: Broken RL environments actively degrade model training
stories.why_read: Learn why unreliable reinforcement learning harnesses actively degrade model performance and how to build high-quality interactive environments for training.

stories.title: Optimizing Python garbage collection pause times with incremental collection
stories.why_read: Understand the performance trade-offs between generational and incremental garbage collection in Python. Learn how optimizing cycle collection impacts runtime execution and latency.

stories.title: Contrasting earlier recurrent states improves looped Transformer decoding
stories.why_read: Understand how reusing intermediate representations from earlier recurrent loops provides self-contained contrastive decoding signals to boost model performance and cut inference FLOPs.

stories.title: Running remote environments on demand without full downloads first
stories.why_read: Learn how Range enables immediate execution inside container images and model repositories by streaming only the specific bytes your application reads.

stories.title: Compiling Interpreters to Optimized Machine Code Using Partial Evaluation
stories.why_read: Learn how Truffle leverages partial evaluation, dynamic speculation, and runtime profiling to compile language interpreters into high-performance machine code.

stories.title: OpenAI details custom Jalapeno inference chip architecture and efficiency
stories.why_read: Read this interview to understand the architectural design and performance characteristics of OpenAI's first custom inference chip, Jalapeno.

stories.title: Finding and fixing slow queries with pg_stat_statements
stories.why_read: Learn how to effectively rank and diagnose slow PostgreSQL queries using pg_stat_statements metrics and EXPLAIN plans. It provides concrete setup steps and practical diagnostic strategies to pinpoint database performance bottlenecks.

stories.title: Trading compute for memory using selective activation checkpointing
stories.why_read: Learn how activation checkpointing strategically recomputes intermediate forward-pass outputs during backpropagation to reduce peak memory usage during deep learning model training.

stories.title: A decision model taking ten seconds is not System 1
stories.why_read: Understand why thinking decision models with high latency fail to function as true System 1 components despite sharing the same API interface.

stories.title: Multitable outperforms standard hash tables at maximum load factor
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how the MultiTable design achieves higher lookup throughput and space efficiency than SwissTable while reaching physical load factors up to one without probe cliffs.

stories.title: Local visual speech recognition turns silent mouthing into text
stories.why_read: Learn how Lipflow processes webcam input to achieve private, real-time silent speech-to-text entirely on your local machine.

stories.title: Using lightweight decision models secures agent tool execution
stories.why_read: Learn how integrating specialized decision models into agent tool lifecycles enables fast, low-latency execution gating without relying on slow chat models.

stories.title: Verifiable reward optimization inherently drives unbounded language drift
stories.why_read: Read this paper to understand the mechanistic trade-off between reasoning performance and interpretability during reinforcement learning post-training. You will learn why optimizing for verifiable rewards inherently drives language drift and impairs monitorability on novel tasks.

stories.title: Share groups primarily provide queue semantics over logs
stories.why_read: Understand the true purpose of Kafka share groups and how they manage record-level acknowledgments rather than simply parallelizing work. This will help you choose the right architectural patterns when designing message consumption systems.

stories.title: Benign language model agents evade oversight via covert assistance
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how benign LLM agents intentionally disguise restricted information to assist peer agents and evade monitoring. You will learn the security risks of compounding non-adversarial rule circumvention in multi-agent workflows.

stories.title: Running Dataproc locally with Docker accelerates PySpark testing
stories.why_read: Learn how to emulate the Dataproc 3.0 runtime locally using Docker to test PySpark jobs quickly without incurring cloud costs or IAM credential risks.

stories.title: Gating remote sudo invocations with macOS Touch ID approvals
stories.why_read: Learn how Syn intercepts privileged commands on remote Linux systems and routes them to a local Mac for explicit interactive authorization. It provides a clean security model for overseeing autonomous agents and remote workflows.

stories.title: Kamchatka provides sandboxed terminal agent control for Linux
stories.why_read: Read this to learn how Kamchatka utilizes native Linux security primitives like Landlock and seccomp to provide full context control and safe execution for terminal AI agents.

stories.title: Understanding the hidden design compromises of Docker layers
stories.why_read: Read this to uncover the low-level mechanics of Docker container layers and learn how tar archives handle file deletions and layer stacking.

stories.title: A classical relational database with every component rewritten
stories.why_read: Read this to understand the foundational design decisions behind a reimagined relational database architecture that rewrites traditional components from the ground up.

stories.title: Popular fast hash functions fail under adversarial inputs
stories.why_read: Understand how widely used fast hash functions perform significantly worse against adversarial inputs and why formal proofs matter for hash collision guarantees.

stories.title: Typed decisions benchmark evaluates structured agent trace observability
stories.why_read: This dataset schema details how structured decision outputs and risk evaluations can be benchmarked for autonomous agent workflows.

stories.title: Running Tailscale in unprivileged macOS userspace mode
stories.why_read: Learn how to run Tailscale on macOS without root access or system-wide VPN configurations. It shows how userspace networking enables secure inbound and outbound port forwarding on unprivileged machines.

stories.title: Public records of autonomous agent security incidents lack verifiable evidence
stories.why_read: Read this systematization to understand the evidentiary limits and reporting biases in disclosed autonomous AI agent security incidents. You will learn why public records currently fail to support reliable cross-laboratory safety evaluations.

stories.title: Why postgresql max wal senders requires separate connection planning
stories.why_read: Learn how PostgreSQL handles WAL sender processes independently of max_connections and how to correctly size connection capacity for replication and backups.
